title: Drop the dangling remedy clause on a ceiling-tier param denial
action: One message regression introduced by cell dod-1 round 2 (commit d5ca8583), found by the goal-check judge as an advisory wart. In the `param-on-nameless-tier` denial the door clause was added around packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/model_guard.rs:658-673. Its `_ =>` fallback at roughly :672 also fires for the `ceiling` tier — `resolve_tier` (around :385-387) returns `Resolved::Inherit` for ceiling — so a ceiling-plus-model-param denial now ends with a dangling clause of the form `...you intended; or dispatch prepare has no --kind for the ceiling tier yet.` That clause offers the reader no remedy at all: it opens with `or` and then names nothing to do. Before dod-1 the message stopped cleanly at `you intended.` FIX: the clause is appended ONLY when there is a remedy to name — a resolving `--kind`, or a slot-own transport (herding-exec, or the configured cli command on stdin). For a tier that resolves to the session model (ceiling, and anything else that resolves to `Resolved::Inherit`), append nothing: the message ends exactly as it did before dod-1. Keep the generation and extraction renderings from dod-1 byte-identical — they are correct and judged PASS. Do not change the `param-on-nameless-tier` deny code string, and do not change which dispatches are allowed, repaired or denied. SECOND, in the same round, delete the dead `"advisor" => Some("advisor")` arm from `dispatch_kind_for_tier` (around :563-570) IF you can first confirm it is genuinely unreachable — `CLAUDE_TIERS` (around :192) carries no `advisor`, and `pinned_type_for` yields only generation/extraction/review, so no caller inside `evaluate_claude_dispatch` can pass `advisor`. If your own reading finds ANY reachable caller, leave the arm alone and say so in the outcome instead of deleting it. Add a test that a ceiling-tier dispatch carrying a model param is denied with a message that does NOT end in a dangling `or` clause — assert the absence of the `has no --kind for the ceiling tier` string.
